sections.en: 2 γεωργείας ('of agriculture') the codex has. 6 διαθίκης ('of a testament') the codex has. 7 εὐροστείας ('of good health') the codex has. μεσουρανιμα ('midheaven') the codex has. The sign ☾ Δ′ I do not understand. 8 ἐγγεῶν ('of lands') the codex has. 12 □ a sign of a planet is required. τριγωνοῦντος ('being in trine') the signs of the planets are omitted by the codex. 14 ξενητείας ('of living abroad') the codex has. 19 ὁρωσκόπου ('of the ascendant') the codex has. 20 τύχην ('fortune') the codex has. 22 πλὶν ('except'). σεσημιωμένων ('of those marked').

sections.en: 2 ὑποδόξαι ('to suspect') the codex has. 3 προσλαβὸν ('having taken in addition') the codex has. 4 ἀπετεῖ ('demands') the codex has, corrected. ἀποστελοῦντος ('sending away') the codex has, corrected by Kroll.

sections.en: 1 [It seemed good to publish at least the beginning of this treatise, of a mathematician by no means ignoble (cf. Heiberg, Ueber Eutokios, Jahrb. für class. Philol., Supplem. XI [1880], p. 357 sqq.), especially since from the chronological marks on p. 171, v. 4, which coincide with the year 498-499 A.D., the opinion of Paul Tannery is brilliantly confirmed, who in the Bulletin des sciences mathématiques, 2nd series, VIII (1884), p. 317 sqq. contends that Eutocius was not, as they used to believe, born in the sixth century but before the year 480. — F. C.]

summary.headline: Astrological Lots and Eutocius
summary.text: Astrological lots for life, partnership, slaves, agriculture, wealth, fortune, spirit, victory, love, marriage, and foreign travel, with planetary distances and aspects. The text then turns to Eutocius’s astrological writings and the casting of lots, trines, houses, exaltations, and depressions.
